title: Route 209 in Kingston
content: Nothing to see here, just a state highway overpass seen from a parking lot.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)I'm pretty sure no one has painted this scene before. That is exciting to me, like being the first artist on Mars.My friendJoe Paquetshared this quote with me: “If your daily life seems poor, do not blame it; blame yourself, tell yourself that you are not poet enough to call forth its riches; for to the creator there is no poverty and no poor indifferent place.”― Rainer Maria Rilke,Letters to a Young Poet
